items.name: Corn on the cob, short cut pieces (2 pieces, kernels only)
items.fdc_query: Corn, sweet, yellow, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt
items.preparation: boiled or steamed, cut into short rounds, no visible butter

fdc.description: Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels on cob, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

rows: Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels cut off cob, boiled, drained, without salt

scale_cues: Square white dinner plate about 25-27 cm across. Each corn round is about 6 cm across including the kernels, which fits a standard ear of sweet corn. From the top view the pieces look about 3-5 cm long.
assumptions: The grams are for the edible kernels only. The cob isn't counted; with the cob, the total would be about 90-120 g.
Each piece is about 3-5 cm long, giving about 20-30 g of kernels per piece.
There's no visible butter, oil or sauce, so none was added.
The corn was boiled or steamed without salt.
